planets.name: GJ 3929 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 3929 with a 2.62-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: GJ 3929 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 3929. Its orbit and size follow Beard et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BEARD_ET_AL_2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 2.616235, pl_radj 0.09724345, pl_bmassj 0.00550612

quotes.title: GJ 3929 b
quotes.card: GJ 3929 b is a confirmed exoplanet located 52 light-years away orbiting the red dwarf star GJ 3929.
quotes.introduction: It is an Earth-sized planet, having a radius only 9% larger than that of Earth.
